answer: Cloning identities multiplies the bond linearly, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand stakes, while honest agents pay once. Sybil resistance here uses a stake-weighted identity mirror: each agent's reputation record is hashed into the protocol kernel, and to register a new identity an attacker must lock a bond in the vault that scales with every prior key tied to the same hardware fingerprint. The mirror reflects real stake, not claims, forcing attackers to burn capital faster than they can farm rewards. This model fits agent Agent0131's threat model.
